candidates.name: Antalya Museum
candidates.content: One of Turkey's largest museums, with 5000 items illustrating the history of the Mediterranean and Pamphylia regions. It's also a repository for some 25,000 items not on display.

candidates.name: Perge
candidates.content: Extensive ruins of a city which had its heyday 2nd to 3rd century AD under the Romans. The site has a colonnaded agora, theatre, stadium, temple to Artemis and two churches.

candidates.name: Aspendos
candidates.content: Graeco-Roman city, of which the centrepiece is the well-preserved amphitheatre, seating 7000. There's also 2 km of aqueduct (which siphoned water over rises), a stadium, baths, basilica, agora and nymphaeum. 1 km downstream near t

candidates.name: Hıdırlık Tower
candidates.content: Built by the Romans in the 2nd century AD with a square base and circular upper storey, this was a bastion and lighthouse. Its present name indicates that it's the site of Hıdırellez on 5/6 May, a religious spring festival.

candidates.name: Tünek Tepe
candidates.content: A hilltop of 618 m with great views over the city and coast, reached by gondola cable car though you can drive or even hike up. Food and drink at the top station are a silly price. The cable car collapsed in April 2024.

candidates.name: Sehzade Korkut Mosque
candidates.alt: Broken Minaret Mosque, Kesik Minare Cami
candidates.content: This was first built as a Roman temple in the 2nd century AD, and in later centuries went back and forth between religions. The minaret was added in the early 13th during one such conversion, and in 1800 this was the only part to

candidates.name: Antalya Aquarium
candidates.content: Huge aquarium with display tanks and long viewing tunnel.

candidates.name: Kurşunlu Waterfall
candidates.content: Woodland park, the waterfalls are impressive in flow but dry to a trickle in summer. A firm path leads you past the best views but is not suitable with restricted mobility. There are refreshment stalls and a café/restaurant.

candidates.name: Fluted Minaret Mosque
candidates.content: Elegant six-domed mosque built under Seljuk rule in 1230 and rebuilt in 1373 by the Hamidids. The minaret is 38 m tall.

candidates.name: Ethnographic Museum
candidates.content: Exhibits traditional arts and crafts.

candidates.name: Atatürk House Museum
candidates.content: Atatürk stayed in Antalya in 1930, 1931 and 1935. This rebuilt mansion shows memorabilia of his times.

candidates.name: Sandland
candidates.content: Sand sculpture park open year round, lit up at night.

candidates.name: Aksu Dolphinarium
candidates.content: Sea lions and dolphins do their splashy stuff at 11:00 and 15:00. Extra charges to swim with them or have a dolphin take a photo of you. People may wish to consider the ethics of such attractions before visiting.

candidates.name: Antalya Zoo
candidates.content: Large spacious zoo park.

candidates.name: King's Pool
candidates.content: An attractive pool in a canyon.

candidates.name: Piyazcı Sami
candidates.content: Antalya-style piyaz (bean salad), kofte and other authentic fare.

candidates.name: Urfali Ciğercİ Apo
candidates.content: Simple place with good food.

candidates.name: Özkan Kebap
candidates.content: Good menu selection, budget place popular with locals.

candidates.name: Çiğköfteci Ömer Usta
candidates.content: Friendly place for çiğ köfte, raw meatballs.

candidates.name: Gizem Cafe Fast Food
candidates.content: Inexpensive place for trad shawarma and dürüm.

candidates.name: Köfteci
candidates.content: Authentically shabby place for Turkish trad food.

candidates.name: Public Konyaaltı
candidates.content: Within the main square on Konyaalti west beach strip, this serves burgers, thin-crust pizza and other filling food.

candidates.name: Yamaçoba
candidates.content: Great quality for inexpensive food at the west end of the beach strip.

candidates.name: Bolero Büfe
candidates.content: Serving lamb, chicken and other meat kebabs. Garlic mayo is available on request.

candidates.name: Ayar Meyhanesi
candidates.content: Friendly restaurant with a great selection of fresh fish. The swimming pool is a puzzle, is it a vivarium where lobsters choose which human bather to eat?

candidates.name: Rokka Pizza Falafel
candidates.content: Good eating place with lots of veggie / vegan choices.

candidates.name: Paradise Restaurant
candidates.content: Sports bar with decent food.
